model.name: gpt-oss-120b (agent)
model.about: OpenAI, mixture of experts (117B, 5.1B active), MXFP4 as released; the larger sibling of the approved 20b. Fits one 80 GB card. Measured on 2026-09-26 with the original harness (eval/RESULTS.md): same answers as the 20b on the twelve original questions, more than twice the GPU time per question, and no wrong draft on the stripped catalog where the 20b made one.

answers.sql:
SELECT d.CHNL_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM   bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON f.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
WHERE  dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP  BY d.CHNL_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER  BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT d_jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
       COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM   bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE  dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP  BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER  BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT fd
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT dt.DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN last_day ld ON f.BUS_DT_K = ld.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM   bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT d       ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND  c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 8
  AND dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_daily_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT m.DSPLY_NM AS market,
       SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_market_valuation DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM   bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE  IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND  OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND  OPND_DT <  DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT dbr.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fat
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fat.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR dbr ON fat.BR_K = dbr.BR_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND ddt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY dbr.CTY_NM
ORDER BY dbr.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D bal
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON bal.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rt
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM   bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE  IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP  BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER  BY segment;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS cust_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS pct_declined
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT dct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM   bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG dct ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = dct.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE  f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND  dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_category;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
       SUM(f.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON f.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees_2025 DESC;

SELECT SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d_jur.dsply_nm AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.jur_k
WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d_dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  AND d_jur.is_curr = TRUE
GROUP BY d_jur.dsply_nm
ORDER BY high_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loans_over_90dpd
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dlq.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT dlp.dsply_nm AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(fl.otstn_prncp_amt) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D fl
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fl.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD dlp ON fl.ln_prd_k = dlp.ln_prd_k
WHERE dt.cal_dt = DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND dlp.is_curr = TRUE
GROUP BY dlp.dsply_nm
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

WITH txn AS (
 SELECT dbr.rgn_cd1, dbr.dsply_nm, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
 FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
 JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.bus_dt_k = ddt.dt_k
 JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR dbr ON f.br_k = dbr.br_k
 WHERE ddt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
 GROUP BY dbr.rgn_cd1, dbr.dsply_nm
), ranked AS (
 SELECT rgn_cd1, dsply_nm, txn_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rgn_cd1 ORDER BY txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
 FROM txn
)
SELECT rgn_cd1 AS region_code, dsply_nm AS branch_name, txn_cnt AS atm_txn_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT dm.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(fa.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_auth_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH dm ON fa.MRCH_K = dm.MRCH_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dm.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_auth_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.bus_id AS customer_business_id,
       SUM(f.stlm_amt) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.cust_k = d.cust_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
WHERE d.is_curr = TRUE
  AND dt.cal_dt BETWEEN '2025-01-01'::date AND '2025-12-31'::date
GROUP BY d.bus_id
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_settlement_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wt.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d1 ON wt.BUS_DT_K = d1.DT_K AND d1.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN at
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON at.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K AND d2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    WHERE at.CUST_K = wt.CUST_K
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF ft
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON ft.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR,
       f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT d.CHNL_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
FROM   bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON f.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
WHERE  dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP  BY d.CHNL_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER  BY txn_cnt DESC;

SELECT d_jur.dsply_nm AS jurisdiction,
       COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_jur.dsply_nm
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT dbr.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR dbr ON f.BR_K = dbr.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dbr.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH month_end AS (
  SELECT dt.DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND dt.MTH_NBR = 8 AND dt.IS_MTH_END
  ORDER BY dt.CAL_DT DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d_cust.BUS_ID) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN month_end me ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = me.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust ON dlq.CUST_K = d_cust.CUST_K AND d_cust.IS_CURR
WHERE dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM   bank_dwh.F_CMPLT c
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON c.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE  dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND ct.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP  BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER  BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH max_aug AS (
  SELECT MAX(d.CAL_DT) AS max_date
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.MTH_NBR = 8
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN max_aug m ON d.CAL_DT = m.max_date
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR,
       f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_daily_mid_rate
FROM   bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT d.bus_id AS market_id,
       d.dsply_nm AS market_name,
       SUM(f.mkt_val1_amt) AS total_market_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT d ON f.mkt_k = d.mkt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
WHERE dt.cal_dt BETWEEN '2025-01-01'::date AND '2025-12-31'::date
  AND d.is_curr = TRUE
GROUP BY d.bus_id, d.dsply_nm
ORDER BY total_market_valuation DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT dbr.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fatm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fatm.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR dbr ON fatm.BR_K = dbr.BR_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND ddt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY dbr.CTY_NM
ORDER BY dbr.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rt
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS cust_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND t.CUST_K IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM   bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND  f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
GROUP  BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER  BY escalated_complaint_count DESC;

answers.sql:
SELECT dch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
       SUM(faf.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE AS faf
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL AS dch ON faf.CHNL_K = dch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS ddt ON faf.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees_2025 DESC;

SELECT SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d ON a.JUR_K = d.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY high_severity_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loans_over_90dpd
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dlq.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%mobile app%'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT lp.dsply_nm AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(b.otstn_prncp_amt) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D b
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON b.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD lp ON b.ln_prd_k = lp.ln_prd_k
WHERE dt.cal_dt = DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND lp.is_curr = TRUE
GROUP BY lp.dsply_nm
ORDER BY lp.dsply_nm;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH txn AS (
 SELECT dbr.RGN_CD1, dbr.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
 FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fat
 JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR dbr ON fat.BR_K = dbr.BR_K
 JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fat.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
 WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
 GROUP BY dbr.RGN_CD1, dbr.DSPLY_NM
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RGN_CD1 ORDER BY txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
 FROM txn
)
SELECT RGN_CD1 AS region_code, DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, txn_cnt AS atm_transactions
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT dm.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(fa.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH dm ON fa.MRCH_K = dm.MRCH_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dm.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d_cust.bus_id,
       SUM(f_wr_trf.stlm_amt) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f_wr_trf
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_wr_trf.bus_dt_k = d_dt.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust ON f_wr_trf.cust_k = d_cust.cust_k
WHERE d_dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  AND d_cust.is_curr = TRUE
GROUP BY d_cust.bus_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_settlement_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers_2025
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT fwr.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwr
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fwr.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND fwr.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
) wr
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT fat.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fat
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fat.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND fat.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
) at ON wr.CUST_K = at.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON c.CUST_K = wr.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_cnt FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
       AVG(ESTMT_ASSTS_AMT) AS avg_customer_lifetime_value
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY avg_customer_lifetime_value DESC;

SELECT f.STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_settlement_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_settlement_amount DESC;

SELECT d.CHNL_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON f.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY d.CHNL_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT d_jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
       COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT dbr.br_k,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM   bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_BR dbr ON f.BR_K = dbr.BR_K
WHERE  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP  BY dbr.br_k
ORDER  BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dl.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dl
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dl.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON dl.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dl.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM   bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND  c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH last_aug_end AS (
  SELECT MAX(cal_dt) AS dt
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE mth_nbr = 8 AND is_mth_end
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bus_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON d.cust_k = c.cust_k
WHERE d.dflt_flg = TRUE
  AND dt.cal_dt = (SELECT dt FROM last_aug_end)
  AND c.is_curr = TRUE;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_daily_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.MID_RT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS market_name,
       SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT d ON f.MKT_K = d.MKT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01'::date AND '2025-12-31'::date
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_market_valuation DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT dbr.cty_nm AS branch_city,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fat
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fat.BUS_DT_K = ddt.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR dbr ON fat.BR_K = dbr.br_k
WHERE ddt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  AND ddt.qtr_nbr = 1
GROUP BY dbr.cty_nm
ORDER BY branch_city;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rt
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT dt.mth_nbr AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY dt.mth_nbr
ORDER BY dt.mth_nbr;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM   bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE  IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP  BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER  BY segment;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS cust_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND t.ACCT_TXN_F_K IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints_2025 DESC;

SELECT ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
       SUM(f.FEE_AMT) AS total_fee
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fee DESC;

SELECT SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d_jur.dsply_nm AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.jur_k = d_jur.jur_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.bus_dt_k = d_dt.dt_k
WHERE f.alrt_svrtY_cd1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d_dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  AND d_jur.is_curr = TRUE
GROUP BY d_jur.dsply_nm
ORDER BY high_alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loans_over_90dpd
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dlq.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE ch.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND d.EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND (d.EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR d.EFF_TO_DT >= DATE '2025-12-31')
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH branch_txn AS (
  SELECT br_k, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fat
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fat.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY br_k
)
SELECT dbr.rgn_cd1 AS region_code,
       dbr.dsply_nm AS branch_name,
       bt.txn_cnt AS atm_txn_count
FROM branch_txn bt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR dbr ON bt.br_k = dbr.BR_K
WHERE dbr.is_curr = TRUE
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dbr.rgn_cd1 ORDER BY bt.txn_cnt DESC) = 1;

SELECT dm.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(fa.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH dm ON fa.MRCH_K = dm.MRCH_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dm.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.BUS_ID,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amt
FROM   bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP  BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER  BY total_amt DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM   bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT fw.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fw
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fw.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND fw.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
) w
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT fa.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fa
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fa.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND fa.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
) a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON c.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF ft
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON ft.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT f.STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;
